safetyPrinciples.clock: UTC timestamps for records; independent monotonic expiry at receiving authority
safetyPrinciples.identity: OS-protected service principal and mutually authenticated peers required in production
safetyPrinciples.lineage: per-message correlationId, immutable eventId, source revision and verified schema version
safetyPrinciples.replay: durable receiver-side idempotency and anti-rollback proofs required for operational commands
safetyPrinciples.trust: schemas do not constitute implementation or authorization

observation.v1.semantics: read-only, typed SI units, invalid/untrusted measurement cannot satisfy safety guard

recommendation.v1.semantics: AI proposal never implies authorization of equipment control

command-request.v1.semantics: not implemented; admission, permit consumption, nonce, fencing and audit required before effect

outcome.v1.semantics: UNKNOWN is a first-class outcome after crash; never infer success from timeout

interfaces.requiredProof: revision, authentication, TTL, same-context binding, no direct control
SI units, quality, time, sequence, fail-safe degraded-power behavior
quality, limit enforcement, independent train stop on unavailable power
signed policy, independently authorized one-use permit, cgroup/MAC fence, safe stop
human/authority approval, bounded command envelope, durable idempotency
survey provenance, validity domain, geotechnical hazard guard
independent root and peer identity, anti-rollback, cross-UID policy, retention
no direct service admission; independently enforced release decision needed
design envelope, finite element/sensor agreement, site permit authority
